In this question, a statement is given followed by two courses of action, numbered I and II. You must assume everything in the statement to be true, and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the given courses of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.Statement: A significant increase in respiratory diseases has been observed in City B due to rising air pollution levels.Couse of Actions:I. The government of City B should provide free masks to all residents of the city.II. The government of City B should enforce stricter emission standards for industries and vehicles in and around the surrounding areas of the city.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Both I and II follow.) है।

questions.question:

‘A : B’ का अर्थ है कि ‘A, B का पिता है’,
‘A $ B’ का अर्थ है कि ‘A, B का भाई है’,
‘A & B’ का अर्थ है कि ‘A, B की पुत्री है’ और
‘A < B’ का अर्थ है कि ‘A, B की पत्नी है’।

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (S : C < K $ I & T) है।

In this question, a statement is followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to assume everything in the statement to be true and decide which of them logically follows beyond a reasonable doubt from the information given in the statement.

Statement: The boys team of school X lost 21 out of 30 basketball matches, but won 18 out of 24 cricket matches that they played this year.

Conclusions:
I. The boys team of school X likes cricket more than basketball.
II. The boys team of school X should start playing football instead of basketball.
options: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Neither conclusion I nor II follows.) है।
